head: iPhone Duo delivery dates move up from January to December for some buyers
dek: Some people who ordered an iPhone Duo from Apple with a 25 January estimate now see 14 to 21 December, a few even 12 to 14 December, according to MacRumors readers. New orders on 12 November still showed 25 January; by 16 November, new orders in the US and elsewhere showed 16 to 23 December, according to 9to5Mac.
